title: Herbal Beef Tripe Stir Fry
description: A savory and aromatic stir fry made with tender beef tripe, infused with herbal flavors.

ingredients.name: beef tripe
ingredients.notes: cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the beef tripe and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced bell peppers, carrots, and mushrooms. Cook until the vegetables are tender-crisp, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the chopped scallions and cook for 1 minute, until wilted.
Return the cooked beef tripe to the skillet and stir in the herbal stir-fry sauce, fish sauce, and soy sauce.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the sauce has thickened and the beef tripe is coated.
Season with black pepper to taste.
Serve hot and garnish with additional scallions, if desired.
